source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek recognizes that the row is not runnable, but then assumes it is a physical connection/continuity test and predicts a future partial BMC console check without source support.

original_test_intent.purpose: The row is intended to validate an I2C-related aspect of an entity labeled FIO_BD, but its purpose is not defined because both Procedure and Criteria are TBD.
original_test_intent.target: Undefined. `FIO_BD` may identify a front-I/O board, but the source does not establish its board revision, I2C controller/master, bus/mux path, address, device, connector or execution side.
original_test_intent.scope: Undefined. Possible interpretations include topology/enumeration, device presence, sensor/FRU data, board communication, cable/connector continuity, active I2C transactions or robustness/recovery; these are not interchangeable.
original_test_intent.operation: Undefined. No physical inspection, continuity measurement, software query, bus transaction, stimulus, power state or manual action is authorized by the source.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 2 attended and 2 machine minutes, but no operation, duration or iteration count is defined.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Undefined because Criteria is TBD; no topology, address, response, measurement, visual state or recovery result can be judged.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Undefined. Evidence requirements depend on the absent choice among physical, electrical and software interpretations.
ambiguities: The acronym/label FIO_BD is not expanded in the source.
The I2C test-set label does not prove a physical continuity test.
No bus, address, device, board drawing, measurement or response semantics exist.
No safety, acceptance or recovery boundary exists.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly forbids invented probing and demands owner inputs, but it classifies the row MANUAL ONLY and defines a physical connection/continuity inspection. Since the source supplies no physical operation or visual/electrical acceptance, that classification is itself an unsupported inference.

applicable_history.decision: V2 selects a manual FIO connection/continuity interpretation. No user ruling, procedure, drawing or later record confirms that interpretation for this source key.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify from MANUAL ONLY to BLOCKED. The essential operation and acceptance are unknown, so neither manual nor automated capability can be assigned safely. Permit only identity/document intake and perform a fresh review after the FIO_BD definition is supplied.

available_now: The unique row, I2C test-set label, FIO_BD item and two TBD fields are known.
Existing platform and board identity can be documented without touching connectors or sending I2C transactions.
missing_inputs: The testcase/FIO owner must define the acronym/entity, exact purpose and whether the test is physical, electrical, firmware or software based.
The board/platform owner must provide exact SUT/FIO revisions, topology/drawing, I2C owner/controller/bus/mux/address/device scope, procedure, power/I/O state, tools, iterations and expected result.
The owner must define evidence, safety/authorization, stop and recovery requirements appropriate to the actual operation.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The testcase owner and FIO/board hardware-firmware owner jointly supply the definition; an automation reviewer assigns capability only after that definition exists.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record existing SUT, FIO board and BMC/firmware identifiers and locate the board/spec reference without manipulating hardware.
Preserve current console/front-I/O/BMC health and logs as intake context; do not treat it as testcase evidence.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not inspect/disconnect/reseat/probe a connector, perform continuity measurement, send I2C/SMBus traffic, change mux/power/I/O state, invent a bus/address, clear logs or claim the test is manual-only.
Do not assume the host or BMC execution location from the I2C label.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Attach an owner-approved procedure and criteria for this exact row, resolve the target and operation unambiguously, verify safety/recovery and then perform a fresh classification/revision. A board drawing alone is insufficient unless it defines the requested test.

revision_candidate.purpose: Do not execute until the owner defines which FIO_BD I2C property or behavior must be validated; do not infer connection, continuity or bus probing from the labels.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Not yet defined. The owner must identify the exact server, FIO board revision, BMC/firmware, I2C ownership and execution location.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Not yet defined. The contract must name the physical/electrical/logical target and any controller, bus, mux, address, device, connector or external I/O boundary.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Expanded FIO_BD definition; objective; platform/topology; exact procedure; criteria; power/I/O state; tools/packages/fixtures; duration/iterations; expected evidence; approval; safety, stop and recovery requirements.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: BLOCKED. Perform no physical, electrical or I2C action. Collect only non-invasive identity and documentation context. Re-review the completed source before creating any execution command or manual procedure.
revision_candidate.preconditions: A complete owner-approved procedure and criteria are mapped to the exact platform; operation type, target, evidence, safety and recovery are deterministic; required operator/tool/package and authorization are available.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Before unblocking: the complete definition and platform mapping. Future photos, measurements or command outputs must be defined by that contract; current inventory does not prove execution or PASS.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: None is currently available because Criteria is TBD.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not guess connector/cable actions, continuity limits, I2C buses/addresses/registers, mux/power state, external signal behavior or execution side; do not clear logs or expose credentials.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner approval is required for the completed definition. Later physical/electrical/I2C actions require the specific authorization assigned during fresh review.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: No manual acceptance boundary can be assigned yet. An engineer must first state whether human observation/measurement is essential or whether the activity is machine-verifiable.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No action is authorized. If an unauthorized action occurred, stop, preserve evidence and use only the platform owner's documented FIO/I2C/console recovery; do not improvise reseating, resets or power cycles.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Procedure or criteria remains TBD; FIO_BD meaning, platform, target, operation, acceptance or recovery is ambiguous; proposed steps rely on an inferred manual or scan interpretation; or any hardware/I2C action is requested before fresh review.

identified_defects: The source defines neither operation nor acceptance.
DeepSeek invents a physical connection/continuity test and future partial BMC workflow.
V2 repeats that interpretation and assigns MANUAL ONLY without an established visual/physical acceptance boundary.
reason_for_change: Manual-only is a capability conclusion, not a safe placeholder for an undefined row. The absent source can describe multiple materially different test types, so V3 retains a genuine semantic block without inventing one.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-HW-00449-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: Both Procedure and Criteria are exactly TBD; the source does not state physical connection/continuity, a software probe, or any acceptance mode.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: All target, operation, evidence and safety semantics remain unresolved.

removed_ambiguities: Rejects physical continuity as an assumed meaning of FIO_BD.
Separates non-invasive intake from test execution.
Defers manual-versus-automated capability until the test is actually defined.
remaining_blockers: Purpose, target, operation, acceptance, evidence, safety and recovery are undefined.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 removes an invented physical/electrical test and prevents MANUAL ONLY from concealing a genuine source-definition failure, while preserving a safe path for owner intake and fresh review.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator recovered that no test operation is defined, permitted only non-invasive identity/document context, rejected I2C enumeration/probing/register reads/continuity/connector/power actions, and defined completion as a recorded BLOCKED handoff rather than PASS/FAIL. It attributed the gaps to DOCUMENT_DEFECT and PLATFORM_HANDOFF_DEFECT; no model-planning error occurred.
